units.source_text: 薰君看见只有一个人睡着，料想是弁君摆布好的，不胜欣喜，心中卜卜地跳动。

en.t: Lord Kaoru saw that only one person was asleep there, and thinking that Ben no Kimi must have arranged it, he was overjoyed, his heart pounding with excitement.

units.source_text: 仔细一看，原来不是大女公子而是二女公子。

en.t: When he looked more closely, he realized that it was not the elder princess, but the younger one.

units.source_text: 相貌相似，而娇美之色胜于乃姐。

en.t: Their features were alike, but in delicate beauty she surpassed her elder sister.

units.source_text: 他看见二女公子惊惶失措之状，知道她原是不知情的，觉得很对她不起。

en.t: Seeing the younger princess so frightened and bewildered, he understood that she had known nothing of this, and felt deeply sorry toward her.

units.source_text: 而转念想到大女公子有意躲避，其冷酷无情实在深可痛恨。

en.t: But then he thought that the elder princess had deliberately avoided him, and he found her cold heartlessness truly bitter and hateful.

units.source_text: 他想：“这二女公子如果为他人所有，实在也舍不得。

en.t: He thought, If this younger princess were to belong to someone else, I truly could not bear to let her go.

units.source_text: 然而违背了我的本意，又很遗憾。

en.t: And yet this goes against my original intention, which is also deeply regrettable.

units.source_text: 我不愿意叫大女公子把我对她的爱情看作一时的浮薄心。

en.t: I do not want the elder princess to think that my love for her was only a passing, frivolous impulse.
For tonight, I should let things pass in a proper and restrained way.

units.source_text: 如果终于逃不了宿缘，对二女公子也发生了爱情，亦无大碍。

en.t: If in the end I cannot escape the bond of fate, and love for the younger princess arises as well, that would be no great harm.

units.source_text: 因为不是别人，是她的胞妹呀。”

en.t: After all, she is no stranger, but that lady's own younger sister.

units.source_text: 他就按住热情，同上次对大女公子一样，温和亲切地同二女公子谈话，直到天明。

en.t: So he held back his passion and, just as he had done before with the elder princess, spoke gently and warmly with the younger princess until dawn.
